title: Boot and controller recovery calibration before flag/AI automatic navigation
objectives: Reproduce game memory-card startup prompt and identify the exact visible screen at each bounded button press
Verify that virtual pad1 button overrides reach the game and can dismiss the prompt without random button-mashing
Capture original main menu screen before attempting Match Mode and Exhibition navigation
Suspend automatic match navigation until verified screen-state signatures are available; preserve flags/names/keeper AI task for later task revisions
limitations: This is a non-destructive startup calibration, not a completed automated Exhibition match. After each input the v0.6.2 runner performs a lightweight screenshot-change check; if no visual response is observed, the run halts with evidence instead of continuing blindly. v0.6.1 still uses older fixed-frame behavior.
